name: fileName
label: File name
help: Name of the file, with its extension. For example, `report.pdf`.

name: data
label: Data
help: Content of the PDF to stamp.

name: text
label: Text
help: Watermark text, up to 50 characters. For example, `CONFIDENTIAL`.

name: password
label: PDF password
help: Only for a PDF that asks for a password to open. The result has no password.
